newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-KEEGAN FANS CAN GET INSURANCE FOR STRESS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KEEGAN FANS CAN GET INSURANCE FOR STRESS.

text.p: An insurance company with a policy against abduction by aliens is ready to offer Newcastle United fans cover for post-traumatic stress after Kevin Keegan resigned as club manager on Wednesday.
London-based insurers Goodfellow Rebecca Ingrams Pearson (GRIP) have already approached one Newcastle firm about the Keegan policy.
But corporate management consultants Paul Davidson Associates (PDA) were not keen on the deal and their spokesman Jeff Watson said: "Being big supporters of Newcastle United we declined the offer."
GRIP managing director Simon Burgess said: "It is a shame that PDA would not take out a policy with us.
"They are very positive about the whole affair but I am sure that does not reflect the attitudes of all Newcastle fans across the country.
"The policy is up and running. Despondent members of the (Newcastle supporters) Toon Army now have somewhere to turn."
